title: I Went (:visited)
summary: A gallery checklist whose ticks turn violet in your eyes but stay unreadable to the page, because every browser lies about :visited to defeat history-sniffing.
mechanism: Same-page hash links become :visited on click (violet to the viewer) while getComputedStyle is forced by the browser's history-sniffing mitigation to always report them as unvisited, so a live detector reads zero.
references: On Kawara, I Read / I Met
CSS :visited history-sniffing mitigation (L. D. Baron / Mozilla, 2010)
